artworks.title: Adelasia of Montferrat as Sinope (Castello della Manta)
artworks.description: Baronial-hall fresco at Manta Castle: a medieval lady stands in for Sinope among the female Worthies — the Asopid nymph who tricked Zeus into granting her perpetual virginity, remembered as a Black Sea eponym and a model of shrewd chastity.
